caseName: Louisiana Railway & Navigation Co. v. Williams
caseNameFull: Louisiana Railway & Navigation Company v. R. E. Williams
summary: Error to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. E. H. Randolph for plaintiff in error., Air. S. P. Jones for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Farrell v. O’Brien, 199 U. S. 89, 100; Toop v. Ulysses Land Co., 237 U. S. 580, 583; Sugarman v. United States, 249 U. S. 182, 184; with imposition of five per cent, penalty under the 23rd Rule.
